markdown: **Activate—Extend Claws** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104). [morph](/Traits.aspx?ID=113)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The bracers fuse temporarily with your forearms, with the claws extending to your fingertips. You gain a climb Speed of 20 feet and a claw unarmed attack with the [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170) and [finesse](/Traits.aspx?ID=179) traits that deals 1d6 slashing damage. This lasts for 10 minutes or until you Dismiss it.
